name: v24-pf-AE04-scene-refused
objective: v2.4 post-freeze AE04-S1 live gate (commit 70b8eed, src/runtime/coordinators/sceneCoordinator.ts sync(): `injected` is set only on an ok WriteResult, a refusal is journaled once per text via deps.journal -> runtimeManager.noteRecap (src/runtime/index.ts)). A REAL scene read (judge plugin, sceneTracker on) injects the tracker block story_orchestrator_scene. Then, synchronously and inside a finally, SillyTavern.getContext is proxied so setExtensionPrompt reads undefined: the host path stHost/extensionPrompts.ts then answers couldNot. Removal: recordSceneRead(null) + 3 syncs -> the block is still held, the coordinator's `injected` is still the held text (not recorded as applied), every sync retried the write (>= 3 setExtensionPrompt lookups), and the journal holds exactly ONE 'The scene tracker could not be removed from the prompt' record carrying the host reason. Proxy removed: one sync lands the removal and adds no journal record. Addition: recordSceneRead(record) + 3 syncs under the proxy -> no block, `injected` null, retried, exactly one more record 'The scene tracker was not added to the prompt'; proxy removed, the block comes back and the journal stays at 2. Frozen 4ebe1db set `injected` before the write, ignored its result and had no journal dep: it fails the `injected`, the retry and the journal assertions. judge.enabled + uses.sceneTracker (and no other use) are switched on install-wide from the recorded starting state; the last step switches the tracker off and asserts the block is gone, then puts the recorded settings back; the runner's restoreJudgeConfig restores them again; diff a run header around the run.

requires.why: the scene read is a real judge plugin call, whose key a no-model lane removes

steps.send: Arin, stay close. We are in the guild hall, and Ponticius has the Sun Ruins contract on the job board.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; const judge = root.settings.judge; globalThis.__ae04scene = { before: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(judge)) }; root.settings.judge = { ...judge, enabled: true, uses: Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(judge.uses).map((use) => [use, use === 'sceneTracker'])) }; const others = Object.entries(root.settings.judge.uses).filter(([use, on]) => on && use !== 'sceneTracker').map(([use]) => use); if (others.length || !root.settings.judge.uses.sceneTracker) throw new Error(`the measured judge state did not take: ${JSON.stringify(root.settings.judge.uses)}`); globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); const status = await fetch('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-judge/status', { headers: SillyTavern.getContext().getRequestHeaders() }).then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : null)).catch(() => null); if (!status?.configured) throw new Error(`the judge plugin is not configured on this install, so nothing can be measured: ${JSON.stringify(status)}`); const scene = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.sceneRunner; if (!scene || typeof scene.sync !== 'function') throw new Error('no scene coordinator attached to the runtime'); if (!scene.families().tracker) throw new Error('sceneTracker is not active after switching it on'); return { sceneTracker: true, startedFrom: { enabled: globalThis.__ae04scene.before.enabled, sceneTracker: globalThis.__ae04scene.before.uses.sceneTracker }, plugin: status.pluginVersion ?? 'configured', model: status.model };

steps.send: Ponticius, read us the contract. We leave for the town gate at first light.

const base = trackerEvents().length; if (base !== 0) throw new Error(`tracker refusal records exist before any refusal: ${JSON.stringify(trackerEvents())}`); const host = globalThis.SillyTavern; const realGetContext = host.getContext; return undefined; } return Reflect.get(target, prop, receiver); } }); }; }; const out = {}; refuse(); try { reads = 0; rt.recordSceneRead(null); scene.sync(); scene.sync(); scene.sync(); out.removal = { writeAttempts: reads, block: block(), injected: scene.injected, journal: trackerEvents() }; if (out.removal.writeAttempts < 3) throw new Error(`DEFECT (AE04-S1): the refused removal was not retried on later syncs (${out.removal.writeAttempts} write attempt(s) over 1 notify + 3 syncs): ${JSON.stringify(out.removal)}`); if (out.removal.journal.length !== 1 || out.removal.journal[0].summary !== 'The scene tracker could not be removed from the prompt' || !String(out.removal.journal[0].detail).includes('cannot be cleared')) throw new Error(`DEFECT (AE04-S1): the refused removal must be journaled exactly once with the host's reason: ${JSON.stringify(out.removal)}`); if (out.removalLanded.journal.length !== 1) throw new Error(`DEFECT (AE04-S1): the removal that landed was journaled again: ${JSON.stringify(out.removalLanded)}`); refuse(); try { reads = 0; rt.recordSceneRead(record); scene.sync(); scene.sync(); scene.sync(); out.addition = { writeAttempts: reads, block: block(), injected: scene.injected, journal: trackerEvents() }; } finally { host.getContext = realGetContext; } if (out.addition.block !== '') throw new Error(`the host held no setExtensionPrompt, yet a block appeared: ${JSON.stringify(out.addition)}`); if (out.addition.injected !== null) throw new Error(`DEFECT (AE04-S1): the refused addition was recorded as applied: ${JSON.stringify(out.addition)}`); if (out.addition.writeAttempts < 3) throw new Error(`DEFECT (AE04-S1): the refused addition was not retried on later syncs: ${JSON.stringify(out.addition)}`); const added = out.addition.journal.slice(1); if (added.length !== 1 || added[0].summary !== 'The scene tracker was not added to the prompt' || !String(added[0].detail).includes('never reaches a prompt')) throw new Error(`DEFECT (AE04-S1): the refused addition must be journaled exactly once with the host's reason: ${JSON.stringify(out.addition)}`); scene.sync(); scene.sync(); out.additionLanded = { block: block(), injected: scene.injected, journal: trackerEvents() }; if (out.additionLanded.block !== held || out.additionLanded.injected !== held) throw new Error(`once setExtensionPrompt is back the tracker must be injected again: ${JSON.stringify(out.additionLanded)}`); if (out.additionLanded.journal.length !== 2) throw new Error(`DEFECT (AE04-S1): a landed write was journaled, or a refusal twice: ${JSON.stringify(out.additionLanded)}`); return out;

const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; const before = globalThis.__ae04scene?.before; if (!before) throw new Error('no judge snapshot to restore'); const scene = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.sceneRunner; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, uses: { ...root.settings.judge.uses, sceneTracker: false } }; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); scene.sync(); if (scene.families().tracker) throw new Error('sceneTracker still active with sceneTracker switched off'); const left = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts?.story_orchestrator_scene?.value ?? ''; if (left) throw new Error(`the tracker block outlived the tracker being switched off: ${left}`); root.settings.judge = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(before)); globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); if (JSON.stringify(root.settings.judge) !== JSON.stringify(before)) throw new Error('judge settings differ from the snapshot after restore'); const want = Boolean(before.enabled && before.uses.sceneTracker); if (Boolean(scene.families().tracker) !== want) throw new Error(`sceneTracker after restore should be ${want ? 'active' : 'inactive'}, as the recorded install had it`); return { restored: true, enabled: root.settings.judge.enabled, sceneTracker: root.settings.judge.uses.sceneTracker, block: left };

_v26: Judge uses default ON since v2.6 rule 5 (user decision 2026-09-30, docs/plans/v2.6/00-overview.md), so the old 'must start off' precondition failed on every install. The fixture now records whatever the install holds, sets its OWN measured state (judge on, ONLY the measured use on, every other use off: the condition the gate was measured in when every use was off by default, and no other use's /systemone request can land in the fetch recorder), switches the measured use off again as a negative control before restoring, then restores the recorded settings and verifies them byte-for-byte; the runner's restoreJudgeConfig restores them again.
